gen-gf-offside-gf-yaldevi: Offside's curves refuse to close, spread wide. Yaldevi, a sans-serif body with oversized lowercase, does the quiet work, its e opening clearly, while the heading holds every stroke constant.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-tiktok-sans: Commanding, scattered, and loud about it. Paprika lets its lowercase fill the line like capitals, while TikTok Sans keeps a tall x-height and a spacious c for the sans text below.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-vend-sans: Wide, loose, and swaggering. Revalia strides across the line with spaced-out letters, and Vend Sans follows with ruler-straight strokes and a tall x-height that would carry a long page without tiring.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-ubuntu-sans: Expressive stencil letters with wide bridges lead, then a plain sans with big-eyed lowercase and rounded, pipe-like strokes follows. Ubuntu Sans is the friendlier half.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads with a marker-like line, bulky lowercase, and distinct gaps in its c, e, s, and a. And Tektur, with its pipe-cleaner strokes up top, gives a long read a livelier start.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text draws a marker-like line with big-bodied lowercase. Tilt Neon, tube-thick and commanding above it, leaves the sans-serif text to carry a long page with curve endings kept well apart.
gen-switzer-fs-erode: Dignified is Erode's mood, with a tall middle band and a gentle ebb and flow of weight. And Switzer, signage-plain and tube-like, would feel stiff if made small beside a classic serif of that size.
gen-tourney-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, with generous space where its curves meet the stem. Bespoke Sans also gains most from a bit more size, since Tourney's bulky, stretched caps already shout.
gen-tourney-gf-abeezee: Tourney cuts every stroke to one width and stretches its bulky letters wide. ABeeZee, a plain sans, reads like neon tubing, with terminals clear of the stem.
gen-tourney-gf-aldrich: Aldrich reads modern, with round letters that look cupped rather than clenched. Its x-height nearly touches the cap height, so a long page feels like tracing one thick thread beneath Tourney's stretched, bulky headings.
